steps.description: Set up JUnit test cases for regression testing using TestNG framework.
Run unit tests using Maven Surefire plugin.
Generate reports using Jenkins reporting plugin.
Review test results and fix any issues found by manual verification.
Update the test suite based on feedback and new requirements.
Create load test scenarios using Apache JMeter.
Execute load tests on the production environment.
Analyze performance data using JMeter's built-in analysis tools.
Document findings and optimize the application for better performance.
Repeat load testing periodically to ensure continuous improvement.
Identify potential security vulnerabilities using OWASP ZAP scanner.
Prioritize vulnerabilities according to severity levels.
Develop patches or updates to address identified vulnerabilities.
Test fixes thoroughly using automated tools like SonarQube.
Submit changes to the development team for integration into the main branch.
Attend regular stand-up meetings to discuss progress and roadblocks.
Review pull requests and provide feedback during code reviews.
Ensure that all changes adhere to coding standards and best practices.
Coordinate with developers to resolve conflicts and merge branches successfully.
Provide guidance on how to improve future iterations of the project.
Update user manuals and API documentation regularly.
Create technical blog posts explaining complex concepts.
Respond to FAQs and support tickets promptly.
Keep documentation up-to-date with the latest features and improvements.
Ensure accessibility and usability guidelines are followed when updating content.
